conclusion.role: fail-closed safety veto on precedent applicability
conclusion.claim_boundary: The audit supports using grounded decisive differences to block precedent transfer. It does not establish that the system can safely recover abstentions when no decisive difference is found.

limitations: Only five preregistered qualitative cases were audited.
LLM outputs are stochastic; this audit does not establish class-wide elimination of AG-13-type failures.
The unclear/recovery path remains weakly evidenced.
S5 is not included in the frozen 168-row aggregate Router metrics.
